prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, mid 40s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, voluminous curls ash brown hair — full body polished banded agate fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING warm caramel and white banded agate surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID concentric rust-red bands flowing through every section, with a carved geometric lattice relief across every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Pose: wide power stance, both fists lightly closed at her sides, chin up — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the banded agate body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left thigh, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her belly and one at her right upper arm, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw pale grey stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the banded agate is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals in red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved banded agate right down to the shoes.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, carved from the same agate with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: thick saturated near-black burgundy lacquer-glossy lips overlined fuller than natural, deep plum-brown smoky eyes, dramatic lashes. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved banded agate.

Background: a sunny city plaza of light paving with a low fountain edge, a street lamp and standard-height shop doors behind her, clear daylight sky, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
